paragraphs: He is mentioned in Zohar, Bereshit 124b, in the Midrash ha-Ne'elam.[^1][^2]

notes.text: קכד: is interpreted as 124b under the colon convention; the English does not literally reproduce the colon. Earlier machine OCR had קבר:. No named Zohar edition is independently checked; Midrash ha-Ne’elam remains part of the citation.
Shalom bar Manyomi is retained with conventional vowels and abbreviated title R'.
